Cat voice recordings: "Cat Purr & Meow" by Kerzoven (2022)
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/cat-purr-meow
License: CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

meow-1.wav: cat_mewfood.wav
meow-2.wav: cat_mewpurr.wav
meow-3.wav: cat_mewpurr2.wav
meow-4.wav: cat_softmew.wav

Edits: trimmed calls, gentle high/low-pass filtering, fades, peak balancing,
and resampling to 32 kHz mono PCM. Small playback-rate variations are applied
in the game. The original recordings are not generated voices.

Background music: original 16-bar composition and Web Audio arrangement
created for Nyang Nyang Drop. Plucked keys, soft bass and brushed percussion.
Score and synthesis are contained in ../../audio.js. No external music samples.
